headline: Pre-K resolution and 10-seat staff pre-K pilot sent to full vote
summary: Staff also previewed a $10.6 million energy savings project and the capital improvement plan. Votes on those items are planned for December.
decisions: Moved the 2018 pre-K resolution to the full board, 3-0.
Moved the one-year employee pre-K pilot of up to 10 seats to the full board, 3-0.
discussion: Pre-K expansion costs: Members asked how many seats would be added, what it would cost, and how much the state would cover. Staff said the state may cover part of the cost, but funding is not guaranteed.
Staff pre-K pilot: Members asked about fairness and how the pilot would be used. Staff said it would start at 10 seats and be reviewed next year.
Energy savings project: Members asked what guarantee means and how payments would flow. Staff said the company must prove the savings, and payments would not exceed the annual savings.
Roof condition and solar: Members asked how many roofs are past their useful life. Staff said most roofs are behind the 25-year replacement schedule, and solar on some roofs would cost more.

Capital plan timeline: Members asked why the capital plan vote comes after a second read and a separate workshop. Staff said the project is large and complex, so the board needs more time to review it.
